data.title: 吹雪 · 海滨俱乐部的冰镇提案
data.description: 【城市海滨俱乐部·午后】吹雪穿着祖母绿连体泳装坐在遮阳篷下，桌上摆着冰镇饮料与一份被海风吹乱的企划；她按住纸张后抬眼微笑，仿佛连度假也能变成一场优雅而有利的谈判。
data.action: 遮阳篷下按住被风吹乱的企划与冰饮，抬眼把度假变成优雅谈判
data.lighting: warm afternoon light under a striped canopy
data.mood: 连海风都被她纳入行程管理
data.promptProse: Fubuki from One-Punch Man wears an emerald one-piece swimsuit with a white beach coat, pearl earrings and a woven sun hat. She sits beneath the club canopy with a chilled drink beside a wind-scattered proposal. She pins the pages beneath one elegant hand and raises her eyes with a calm smile, turning the small interruption into another polished negotiation with the afternoon. warm afternoon light under a striped canopy.
